description: Several photos are added to a shared album over ten minutes. Why does each member receive at most one 'new media' email, how is the delay implemented, and which components are involved from the moment a photo is added to the SMTP send?
anchor_note: non-bug task: root_cause_symbols holds the anchor (entry point / changed symbol); RC metrics are reported for category A only
alternatives: Adding assets via the album endpoint emits the same event from AlbumService.addAssets (album.service.ts:197) instead of AssetMediaService.addToSharedLink.

source.verification: server/src/services/notification.service.spec.ts describe 'onAlbumUpdateEvent' (line 178; assertions not read - UNVERIFIED); regression tests added by commits fea0db02f and 5d7283e44 in server/src/services/asset-media.service.spec.ts.
source.notes: The delay is BullMQ job delay + deterministic jobId; debouncing = remove-then-requeue. Confounder: the job payload carries delay so the delay value is read in getJobOptions, not in the handler.

evidence: server/src/services/notification.service.ts:35 albumUpdateEmailDelayMs = 300_000; :234-247 onAlbumUpdate; :390 handleAlbumUpdate; :403 / :496 sendAlbumLocalNotification; :433 queue SendMail; :446-454 handleSendEmail
commits fea0db02f (PR #29757), 5d7283e44 (PR #30120) fixed missing emits on this chain

notes: Chain verified: AlbumUpdate emit -> NotificationService.onAlbumUpdate (notification.service.ts:234-247: removeJob then queue NotifyAlbumUpdate with delay 300000 ms, jobId `${id}/${recipientId}` via JobRepository.getJobOptions :256-263, removeJob :291-296) -> handleAlbumUpdate (:390) -> sendAlbumLocalNotification -> queue SendMail (:433) -> handleSendEmail (:446) -> EmailRepository.sendEmail.

Entry point choice is poor: AssetMediaService.addToSharedLink (asset-media.service.ts:354-366) is the anonymous upload-through-shared-link path; "photos are added to a shared album" normally goes through AlbumService.addAssets (album.service.ts:190-197), which the draft only lists as relevant/alt. Use AlbumService.addAssets as the first step (accept addToSharedLink as alternative).
